version_name: WP5 intervention designer — mode C, before/after, Apply to project
features: WP5 intervention designer mode C (D5.3): re-weights existing links with the sign fixed and strength weak, medium or strong; combines with new node and new edges in one design (WS-7b).
Link ranking by dominant-eigenvalue sensitivity, and a "What success depends on" table of decisive links (30-success threshold) (WS-7b).
Compare structure: loops gained, lost and changed, leverage top 10 and Boolean attractors, before and after a design, as a background job (WS-7b).
Apply to project: writes a Scenario Builder scenario with ops records and links_modified (matched by link endpoints); Scenario Builder shows modified links and their impact (WS-7b).

medium: Scenario Builder impact analysis crashed on scenarios that remove a link.
Added links failed to bind to baseline edges that carry extra columns.
performance: ML connection suggestions: batch graph-feature extraction computes paths, neighbours and centrality once per call instead of per pair; 2000 pairs on a 200-node network went from 35 s to 0.2 s with identical output (1.26.1).
high: Auto-save backups wrote empty fields without null, so recovery could drop a whole element category; the loader now binds rows by key union, so older backups recover too (WS-4).

migration_notes: Projects that use a WP5 indicator are stamped min_app_version 1.24.0; 1.23.0 and older would drop the indicator columns on save.
